title: Northbeam TechWorks Attendance Surcharge Outside Ordinary Hours
content:
Where an attendance on a Northbeam TechWorks Installation and Repair job was carried out at a weekend or outside the service's ordinary hours, the surcharge that attendance adds is booked as a charge of its own against the line of work it belongs to, and it is booked once for that attendance.

The surcharge stands on the job as its own entry, alongside the labour it was worked out from, and raises the service charges outstanding on the job by the amount booked. It is not folded into the labour entry and is not a second labour charge.

## Booking the surcharge

The desk books the surcharge with the agent-side tool `bill_out_of_hours_surcharge_9a215bff`, which is unlocked and then called by the agent. It is not listed among the ordinary desk tools and is reached only once unlocked.

One call books one surcharge entry on the job for that attendance and raises the job's outstanding service charges by the amount booked, so the customer's next statement of the job shows the surcharge alongside the labour it was worked out from. The entry is dated the day it is booked and is taken as a telephone entry.

## The five values the call carries

| Value | What it is | Format |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `service_agreement_id` | the reference number of the TechWorks work order or care agreement the surcharge belongs to, read from the work orders held on the customer's profile before the call | an identifier |
| `customer_id` | the reference number of the customer profile being billed, read from that profile before the call | an identifier |
| `work_order_line_reference` | the reference number of the single line of work the surcharge is settled against, read from the entries already booked on that job before the call | an identifier |
| `visit_date` | the day the attendance the surcharge arose on took place, in the retailer's own local calendar | a date written as YYYY-MM-DD, never left empty |
| `surcharge_amount` | the surcharge to bill | USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed; the figure itself, never a rate or a percentage |

## What the call returns

A one-line confirmation string naming the surcharge entry reference that was created, the job it was booked on, the amount booked in USD to two decimal places and the job's new outstanding service charges in USD to two decimal places. The presence of that entry reference in the reply is what shows the surcharge was booked.

On success the job carries one more charge and a higher outstanding figure, and the customer can be told the surcharge is now on the bill.

## Points of judgement on the entry

**One attendance, one surcharge entry.** The surcharge is booked once for the attendance it arose on, against the line of work that attendance belongs to.

**The attendance day and the booking day are different things.** The day carried on the entry is the day the attendance took place; the day the entry itself is dated is the day it is booked.
